Name: Three Creek Farm
Author: xChesirex
Description:
A simple yet large map that replaces vanilla's Riverland land, perfect for singleplayer or multiplayer! 

Config options include : 
-Waterfalls 
-Decoration 

The waterfalls version ( My favorite version personally ) includes invisible fences to prevent farm animals from escaping on the lower left cliff area, allowing them to free roam with their very own pond for the ducks! 


This is my first "large" mod, and my first farm map in general, so please be gentle with me! But make sure to point out any bugs or weird things about the maps! And if you have any suggestions for possible decor ( Note, I will not include everything, but I will think about each thing! ) , secret areas that you can walk off to, future farm maps, or just general critiques, just drop them in the posts tab!

Downloads.Description: A minor json edit, the hardwood stumps should be respawnable, please let me know if they aren't!
